_doc: #1954 the Orch > Home pipeline flow: the stages a change passes (source -> CI workflows -> build -> registries -> deploy -> running) and the pipelines that cross them. Read by pages/OrchFlow.kt; the live last-run status of every stage is FOLDED from sources the Orch pages already read (GitHubFeed runs, DaguRunsFeed, c3-infra-api /db/deploy/history and /health/deployed/:vm), never typed here. `from` names the live sources, `open` is the declared Orch/Containers page that owns the stage (long-press). Workflow names are never typed: they are the distinct run names of the runs feed. Every pipeline repo must be in data/repos_declared.json (by name or github).

status_rules.bad: the newest run of any workflow failed
status_rules.warn: a run is in progress, or the newest run is older than stale_after_minutes
status_rules.unknown: the source could not be read (the stage prints why, never a zero)
